text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no wonder you've been so happy<n>today! You
got a fan letter, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-you don't have to announce it to<n>the world! Urgh...
Was I being that<n>obvious about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Probably more than you think.<n>So what's it
say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... They said they've been<n>watching me in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And... that I looked cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you laughing about?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nothing. Just thinking back on an old<n>memory.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's amazing! They run inraces and perform in concerts!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They're so cool! So this is what<n>the Twinkle
Series is about!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do that too! I wanna run in<n>incredible races
and perform<n>awesome dances!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know you can do it, Dober. I can't<n>wait to see you
on stage!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You have to dance with me too,<n>Ryan! We can
both wear sparkly<n>clothes and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stop, stop, stop!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to bring that up! That<n>was so long
ago!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. You were so cute then, I<n>couldn't help
myself. Anyway, what I<n>wanna say is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You've come so far. You've gone<n>from being an
admirer to someone<n>who has admirers of her own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Admirers of my own, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are so many things I still can't<n>do, but... I
guess I've also come a<n>long way since then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you ask me, you've already<n>made your
wish from back then come<n>true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta do my best too! It's my<n>job to dance
next to you in a sparkly<n>outfit, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
C-cut it out already! That's practically<n>ancient
history!
